explanation: The removal of the custom Arrow data serializer (which fixed the zero-copy slice pickling bug ARROW-10739) and the deletion of `_register_arrow_data_serializer` means Arrow tables/arrays that are zero-copy slices will again serialize their entire underlying buffer instead of just the slice, potentially causing large memory blowups or data corruption during serialization.
